name: Caleb Theodros

items.text: In 2024, primary runner-up Lucille Puckett challenged Theodros's residency. The county elections board unanimously dismissed it, saying he gave "substantial" evidence. He said he moved in July 2023 but updated his voter registration late. He also reported a GPS tracker on his car; police had no suspects.
items.why: The residency challenge touches commitment to the area (criterion 1), but the county board rejected it after a hearing, and the tracker was reported by him as a victim, so no wrongdoing was found.

for_review: I did not find what happened with Puckett's stated plan to appeal the county board's April 2024 dismissal to the State Board of Elections. Theodros took office in January 2025, which suggests it went nowhere, but check this. I did not read the county board's written order or the police report.
